oracle.R1: eshop-sut/README.md line 104 — only a logged-in user can check out
oracle.R2: eshop-sut/README.md line 105 — the total is computed automatically from the cart and the user may not edit it directly
oracle.R3: eshop-sut/README.md line 106 — the interface displays the full list of ordered products
oracle.R4: eshop-sut/README.md line 107 — the backend must recompute the total; a client-sent total_amount is not accepted
oracle.R5: eshop-sut/README.md line 108 — after a successful checkout, the cart is cleared

A-08-1.statement: R3's "đầy đủ" (full/complete) is read as requiring each ordered product's identity to be visible. Whether the quantity and line amount must ALSO be shown is an inference from "full", not a quoted requirement.

A-08-2.statement: R3 applied to an empty cart means the displayed list is empty — the page must not fabricate line items. The spec does not discuss checkout with an empty cart at all.

note: Expected totals are NEVER hardcoded. R2 states a RELATIONSHIP (total = computed from cart), so the expected value is computed at runtime as the sum of line amounts, using catalogue prices read from GET /api/products — an independent source, not the checkout page's own display. Hardcoding 30000000 here would make the oracle depend on the SUT's seed data instead of on the spec, and would break silently whenever the catalogue changes.
schemaNote: expectedTotalRule: 'sumOfLineAmounts' means expected = Σ(catalogue price × quantity) over the seeded products. seedVia: 'home' adds quantity 1 per click from the product grid; 'productDetail' uses the detail page's quantity input (required for quantity > 1, because addToCart appends a new line rather than merging).
